note: 15 pilot theorems tagged by two independent taggers; flags mark routes that must not raise a diversity score.

flags.not-the-stated-theorem: proves a variant, not the stated theorem
flags.sketch-mismatch: catalog sketch belongs to another route or theorem; tagged from title
flags.title-sketch-mismatch: title and sketch name different routes; tagged from sketch
flags.sketch-self-corrects: sketch retracts a claim; tagged the corrected route
flags.derivesFromTheorem-note: derivesFromTheorem is a modifier, not a flag: the route is kept and shown.
